# Frozen public Observer corpus

These metadata-only fixtures come from the independently accepted Observer
`0.2.0a3` source checkpoint `222c5bf`. `SOURCE.json` records the accepted wheel
hash, contract versions and exact fixture digests. Consumer tests verify those
bytes and exercise host-scoped projections, partial feeds, watch gaps and write
request/plan/result semantics. These are synthetic contract fixtures, not native
provider acceptance evidence.
